item.title: Beyond the Shinkansen Stop: Saga
item.description: The Kyushu Shinkansen stops at Shin-Tosu, and almost everyone stays on the train. Here's why you should get off for the porcelain villages, the squid market, and the sky full of hot air balloons.

item.title: Japan's Most Scenic Local Train Rides: 5 Routes Worth the Detour
item.description: Five of Japan's most beautiful local train journeys — coastal cliff lines, highland valleys, and routes where you might be the only foreign passenger on board.
